content: 1. When assessing the relevance of an interest, items 1 and 2 should only be declared if they are current. For items 3, 4, and 5, any interest within the past four years must be declared. If the interest is no longer current, the year it ceased should be specified. For item 5, the interest is considered to have ceased when a financed position or fellowship is no longer held, or when support for an activity has ended. 2. The information you provide will be used to evaluate whether the declared interests represent a significant real, potential, or apparent conflict of interest. Depending on the situation, such a conflict may result in one of the following outcomes: (i) you may be asked not to participate in the portion of the discussion or work related to the interest, (ii) you may be asked not to participate in the meeting or work entirely, or (iii) with your agreement and if deemed appropriate by FAO, you may participate in the meeting or work with your interest publicly disclosed. 3. Information disclosed on this form may be shared with individuals outside FAO only if the objectivity of the meeting or work is questioned, and the Director-General determines that disclosure is in the best interest of the organization. This will only occur after consultation with you. 4. You and your partner must declare any financial or other interests related to the subject matter of the meeting or work in which you are involved, which could constitute a real, potential, or apparent conflict of interest. If applicable, provide details such as patents, shares, employment, associations, or payments, including specifics about any compound, work, or related matters. 5. If you have any other circumstances that could affect your objectivity or independence in the meeting or work, or the perception of your objectivity and independence by others, you must disclose them. 6. By signing this form, you confirm that the disclosed information is accurate and that no other real, potential, or apparent conflict of interest is known to you. You also agree to inform FAO of any changes in these circumstances, including if an issue arises during the meeting or work itself. 7. WHO requires external experts involved in global health issues to disclose any circumstances that could give rise to a potential conflict of interest related to the subject of their involvement. This includes any interest that may affect or reasonably be perceived to affect the expert's objectivity and independence. 8. You must disclose any financial, professional, or other interests relevant to the subject of the work or meeting in which you are participating, as well as any interest that could be influenced by the outcome of the meeting or work. 9. Failure to fully complete and disclose all relevant information on this form may result in WHO deciding not to appoint you to advisory roles or functions in the future. 10. This form must be completed and submitted to the WHO Secretariat at least four weeks, but no later than two weeks, before the meeting or work. You must also promptly inform the Secretariat of any changes to this information before or during the meeting or work. 11. Answering Yes to a question on this form does not automatically disqualify you or limit your participation in a WHO activity. Your responses will be reviewed to determine whether a conflict of interest exists and, if so, its relevance and significance. 12. If a declared interest is deemed significant, measures to manage the conflict may include: (i) exclusion from relevant parts of the meeting or work, (ii) exclusion from the entire meeting or work, or (iii) disclosure of the interest to other participants and inclusion in the activity with appropriate transparency. 13. All potentially significant interests will be disclosed to other participants at the start of the activity, and you will be asked if there have been any changes. A summary of all declarations and actions taken to manage declared interests will be published in resulting reports and work products. 14. If the objectivity of the work or meeting is later questioned, the contents of your Declaration of Interest form may be disclosed to individuals outside WHO if the Director-General considers it in the organization's best interest, following consultation with you. 15. Completing this form signifies your agreement to these conditions. If you are unable or unwilling to disclose details of an interest that may pose a conflict, you must disclose that a conflict may exist. The Secretariat may then decide, after consultation with you, that you should be entirely recused from the meeting or work. 16. You must declare any employment, consulting, research support, investment interests, intellectual property rights, public statements, or positions that could be relevant to the subject of the meeting or work. This includes any financial or non-monetary support received within the past four years. 17. If you have worked for a competitor of a product under discussion, or if your participation could provide access to a competitor's confidential information or create a competitive advantage, you must disclose this. 18. If the outcome of the meeting or work could benefit or adversely affect the interests of others with whom you have substantial common interests, you must disclose this. 19. If any person or entity, excluding WHO, has paid or contributed to your travel costs in connection with the meeting or work, you must disclose this. 20. If you have received payments or honoraria for speaking publicly on the subject of the meeting or work, you must disclose this. 21. If there are any other aspects of your background or current circumstances not addressed above that might affect your objectivity or independence, you must disclose them. 22. Within the past four years, if you have had any professional relationship with an entity involved in the production, manufacture, distribution, or sale of tobacco or tobacco products, or represented the interests of such an entity, you must disclose this. 23. If you answer Yes to any question, you must provide a detailed explanation of the circumstances, including the nature of the interest, the parties involved, the timeframe, and any other relevant details. 24. By completing and signing this form, you consent to the disclosure of any relevant conflicts to other meeting participants and in the resulting report or work product. 25. You declare on your honor that the disclosed information is true and complete to the best of your knowledge. You agree to promptly notify WHO of any changes to the information, including those occurring before or during the meeting or work, and up to the publication of the final results or completion of the activity.
